title: Stalk kernel span of exterior tensor quotient relations
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], S=(K→B→C) a short exact sequence of module sheaves, A a module sheaf, and r,s natural numbers with s≠0. Use exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] and module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Let q:(exteriorSheaf A r) tensor (exteriorSheaf B s)→(exteriorSheaf A r) tensor (exteriorSheaf C s) send every tensor of wedges of sections to the tensor with the second wedge mapped by g. For each open V let Q(V) be the O_X(V)-span of wedge(a) tensor wedge(c) with c_j=f(d) for some j and d in K(V). For x in X let Q_x be the O_{X,x}-span of all germs at x of elements of Q(V), where V ranges over neighborhoods of x. Then the kernel of the O_{X,x}-linear stalk map q_x is contained in Q_x.

proof.text: Map the short exact sequence by the module-to-abelian-sheaf forgetful functor, using lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful for finite limits and colimits, and then by the exact abelian stalk functor. This gives range(f_x)=ker(g_x) and surjectivity of g_x. Obtain exterior stalk comparisons from lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-stalk-comparison and compose the tensor stalk comparison of lem-pc-ringed-space-module-stalk-tensor with their tensor product.

Check that the transported q_x is id tensor exteriorPower.map s g_x. Apply TensorProduct.ext, exteriorPower.linearMap_ext and AlternatingMap.ext in both factors. Represent the two finite tuples on a common neighborhood by induction on their lengths using exists_le_germ_eq. The formula hq, the stalk-map germ formula and the two comparison formulas identify both maps on these generators. Apply lem-sc-exterior-tensor-quotient-kernel-algebra to the transported kernel element.

Induct on membership in the algebraic relation span. Represent the preimage d, then the a and c tuples on successively smaller neighborhoods. Replace c_j by f(d) on the last neighborhood. Its germ remains c_j by naturality of the stalk map and the generator equality. This yields a genuine sectionwise relation without a further equality-of-germs shrinking step. The tensor comparison sends its germ to the given algebraic generator. Thus its inverse lies in the defining stalk span. Linearity handles zero, addition and scalar multiplication. Apply this to the transported kernel element and cancel the comparison with its inverse.

theorem exteriorTensor_stalk_kernel_le_relationSpan {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (A : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (q : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ s ⟶
      exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ s)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      q.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ s U c)) =
        tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf A r) (N := exteriorSheaf S.X₃ s)
          (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ s U (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i))))
    (x : X) :
    LinearMap.ker (q.stalkLinearMap x) ≤ exteriorTensorRelationStalkSpan S A r s x
